operating_notes.text: Green power mix rose to 43% in FY26 compared to 34.4% in FY25.
Imported fuel costs averaged USD 122 per tonne in Q4 FY26, remaining broadly stable YoY.
Domestic grey cement capacity surpassed 200 MTPA as of FY26.
Green power share reached approximately 43% of total power needs.
Green power capacity at 1,897 MW met 47% of power requirements at the end of Q1FY27.
Cement lead distance reduced to 360 km in Q1FY27 from 367 km.
India Cements brand migration to UltraTech is 100% complete; EBITDA per ton reached ₹603 in Q1FY27.
Domestic grey cement sales volumes reached 35.94 million tonnes in Q2FY27, up 13.8% YoY.
Consolidated domestic grey cement capacity stood at 210.1 mtpa as of September 30, 2026.
Pet coke dependence reduced to 25% of overall fuel mix.
Ultravolt wires and cables business launched on Sept 3, 2026.
Domestic grey cement capacity reached 204.7 MTPA in September.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹25,799.47 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹2,982.76 Cr.
On 27th April 2026, UltraTech Cement informed the exchange about the availability of the Q4FY26 earnings call audio recording.
UltraTech Cement reported crossing 200 MTPA capacity in FY26, completed 100% brand migration for acquisitions, and recommended a dividend of ₹240 per share during its Q4 FY26 earnings call.
UltraTech Cement received an income tax assessment order for AY2023-24 with a demand of ₹808.78 Cr.
Grasim Industries Limited, on behalf of **Shri Kumar Mangalam Birla** and 24 other promoters/PACs, declared no new encumbrances on UltraTech Cement shares as of March 31, 2026.
UltraTech Cement announced shareholder approval for material related-party transactions with The India Cements Limited via postal ballot.

On 23 July 2026, UltraTech Cement filed the transcript of its Q1FY27 earnings call, where management reported 13.1% domestic volume growth, EBITDA of ₹5,146 Cr and PAT of ₹2,604 Cr, and guided double-digit volume growth for FY27.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹23,295.07 Cr (+18.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹1,493.77 Cr (+21.3% YoY).
On October 19, 2026, UltraTech Cement approved a corporate guarantee of up to USD 55 mn for its associate UHG Holdings IFSC Private Limited.
UltraTech Cement reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹23,024 Cr and net profit of ₹1,501 Cr.
UltraTech Cement reported 21% profit growth in Q2FY27, launched its 'Ultravolt' electricals business, and reiterated its 240 MTPA capacity target.
